title: Backend: Course CRUD API — POST / GET[id] / PATCH / DELETE
content:
Implement 4 API routes for course management.

## POST /api/admin/courses
- Zod validation schema matching Course model (nameZh, nameEn, slug auto-generate from nameEn if empty, category, cpdHours, price, capacity, deliveryMode, language, iaRefNumber, etc.)
- Auto-generate slug from nameEn if not provided (kebab-case, append random suffix if duplicate)
- Set default registrationStatus to OPEN
- Admin role guard (session.user.role === 'ADMIN')
- Return 201 with created course

## GET /api/admin/courses/[id]
- Fetch single course with relations (generalInstructor, schedule count, registrant count)
- Admin role guard
- Return 404 if not found

## PATCH /api/admin/courses/[id]
- Zod validation for updatable fields
- Admin role guard
- Return 200 with updated course
- Return 404 if not found

## DELETE /api/admin/courses/[id]
- Check registrant count first: if > 0, return 409 Conflict with message
- Cascade: delete related SyllabusItems, Schedules, ScheduleInstructors, ScheduleTopics, Reviews, Faqs
- Set registrationStatus to CLOSED before delete (soft approach) or hard delete if no registrants
- Admin role guard
- Return 200 on success
acceptance: POST creates course with auto-slug, returns 201
GET[id] returns full course object, 404 if missing
All routes require admin role, return 401/403
Zod validation returns 400 on invalid input
npm run typecheck && npm run lint pass
verification: npm run typecheck && npm run lint && curl POST/PATCH/DELETE endpoints with valid/invalid payloads
